inputs.feature_idea: Let agency admins approve expenses in bulk from the weekly digest email.

good.problem: Admins approve expenses one at a time.

user_stories.story: As an admin, I want to select many expenses so that I can approve them at once.
acceptance_criteria: Selecting 20 expenses and approving marks all 20 approved

user_stories.story: As an admin, I want to approve from the digest email so that I skip logging in.
acceptance_criteria: The digest has an Approve all link

requirements.requirement: Signed approval link in the digest

open_questions: Is there an approval limit per batch?
